# events-shows: concerts, Broadway, orchestra, comedy and touring shows, Sep 28, 2026 to Apr 30, 2027

## What is covered (197 events)

Performances at the region's major venues, each with its date and, where published, its start time (24-hour, New York), taken from the venue's or promoter's own page wherever that page could be read:

- **Straz Center** (14): the 2026-27 Broadway season as far as it could be confirmed. Buena Vista Social Club (Oct 6-11), Hamilton (Oct 21-Nov 8), Death Becomes Her (Dec 8-13), Wicked (Feb 3-28, 2027), The Sound of Music (Mar 9-14, 2027) and Oh, Mary! (Apr 6-11, 2027), each confirmed on the touring production's own tour page. Also Tampa Repertory Theatre (Peter and the Starcatcher, Miracle on 34th Street), Jobsite Theater (Misery, Much Ado About Nothing, John Proctor is the Villain), Vitamin String Quartet & Girl Named Tom, Black Violin and the Rocky Horror Spooktacular.
- **Mahaffey Theater** (38): 18 Florida Orchestra programs (Masterworks, Raymond James Pops, family and holiday concerts) and 20 other shows (UB40, Jodeci, BEAT, David Foster & Katharine McPhee, John Oliver, Josh Johnson, Kathleen Madigan, Shen Yun, ballets, holiday shows).
- **Ruth Eckerd Hall Experience** (Ruth Eckerd Hall 47, 1 of them in the Murray Theatre; The BayCare Sound 13; Capitol Theatre 5): headline concerts, the 2026-27 Broadway Series titles in the window, family shows, comedy, and 10 Florida Orchestra concerts at the hall.
- **Benchmark International Arena** (15): the concert calendar (Rush on two nights, Jonas Brothers, Weezer, Smashing Pumpkins, Doja Cat, Hans Zimmer, Don Omar and others).
- **Raymond James Stadium** (4): Karol G, Ed Sheeran, Chris Brown & Usher (two nights), Kenny Chesney.
- **MIDFLORIDA Credit Union Amphitheatre** (8) and **Yuengling Center** (10): every Live Nation-listed show in the window.
- **Tampa Theatre** (9): comedy, film with a live score and concert listings (Bassem Youssef, Daniel Sloss, Leslie Jones, Blade Runner Live, The Fab Four, Croce Plays Croce and others).
- **Jannus Live** (17) and **The RITZ Ybor** (7): a selection of the best-known touring acts from long club calendars.
- **American Stage** (4) and **freeFall Theatre** (5): each company's productions in the window. **Hard Rock Event Center** (1).

Counts by kind: concert 121, theater 27, classical 20, comedy 14, family 7, dance 6, film 1, talk 1. By month: Sep 4 (runs that began earlier, or shows on Sep 29-30), Oct 57, Nov 47, Dec 28, Jan 17, Feb 13, Mar 18, Apr 13. By area: downtown-clearwater 65, downtown-stpete 58, downtown-tampa 23, channel-district 15, north-tampa 10, east-tampa 9, ybor-city 7, west-stpete 5, west-tampa 4, and 1 with location text only.

## How candidates were found

The session's WebSearch budget was already used up, so discovery went through the venues' own calendars and a few listing sites:
- Venue calendars read directly: rutheckerdhall.com (all 13 listing pages through WebFetch; each detail page with curl, for doors, start time and performances), themahaffey.com (the listing and all 78 show pages), raymondjamesstadium.com/events, jannuslive.com (home page and its WordPress events sitemap), theritzybor.com/events, casino.hardrock.com/tampa/events, americanstage.org (season and show pages), freefalltheatre.com, jobsitetheater.org, tamparep.org.
- Live Nation venue pages (JSON-LD) for the amphitheatre and the Yuengling Center, then each Live Nation event page.
- The touring productions' own tour pages for the Straz Broadway titles (hamiltonmusical.com, buenavistamusical.com, deathbecomesherbroadway.com, tour.wickedthemusical.com, soundofmusicontour.com, ohmaryplay.com). The lineup itself came from BroadwayWorld's Tampa listings, read with WebFetch.
- JamBase venue and show pages (JSON-LD with date, start time and performers) for Benchmark International Arena, cross-checked against its Yuengling and Jannus listings. Artist sites where they list the Tampa date: philwickham.com, ilvolomusic.com, donomar.com, hanszimmerlive.com, tobymac.com.
- Creative Loafing's community calendar, where Tampa Theatre and the Straz post their own listings ("User Submitted"), for Tampa Theatre and extra Straz shows.

A script confirmed that every description appears verbatim in its source page. A second script checked every date, and every start time a source gives, against the source page text. The only misses are 4 arena records: their artist pages give the date but no time, and the time comes from JamBase, as their notes say.

## Blocked official sites (read before verifying)

These sites returned no content to curl or WebFetch: strazcenter.org (Incapsula and Queue-it), tampatheatre.org and its Etix ticket pages (captcha), benchmarkintlarena.com (SiteGround captcha), floridaorchestra.org (SiteGround captcha), yuenglingcenter.com, operatampa.org (503), Ticketmaster (403) and the Visit Tampa Bay events API (Akamai). Each record's notes name the substitute page. For 11 arena concerts the only readable source was JamBase, and those records say so.

## Deliberately left out

- Opera Tampa's season, Next Generation Ballet's Nutcracker and The Florida Orchestra's Straz Center (Tampa) performances: no readable page gave dates. The TFO programs are covered through their St. Petersburg (Mahaffey) and Clearwater (Ruth Eckerd Hall) performances.
- TFO morning matinees and "Inside the Music" talks; tribute bands at the Mahaffey (7 Bridges, MJ Live, Classic Seger, The Rocket Man Show); club nights, DJ parties and local acts at Jannus Live and the RITZ; the Hard Rock's pool parties.
- Monster Jam and The Hondo Rodeo Fest at Raymond James Stadium: events-sports (monster-jam-tampa-2027) and events-spring (hondo-rodeo-fest-tampa-2027) already carry them with the same facts. Tampa Theatre's 100th birthday (Oct 15) is in events-fall (tampa-theatre-100th-birthday-2026). Sunset On The River Music & Arts Festival (Feb 20-21, 2027, Julian B. Lane Riverfront Park, listed by the RITZ) is a festival for events-spring.
- JamBase's arena listings for 21 Savage (Oct 31) and Master P (Nov 7), whose bills looked unreliable, and Los Tigres del Norte (Oct 2), which JamBase marks postponed.
- Shows after Apr 30, 2027 (Beetlejuice at Ruth Eckerd Hall on May 10, TFO's May concerts, Jobsite's Proof and The Hobbit, freeFall's A Commercial Jingle for Regina Comet).

## Open questions for the verifier

1. The Straz 2026-27 Broadway season may have more titles than the six confirmed here: BroadwayWorld's Straz listings named these six, and the Straz season page could not be read.
2. Eleven Benchmark International Arena records rest on JamBase alone. Please confirm them on Ticketmaster or the arena site if either can be reached.
3. Ginastera's Harp Concerto (TFO): the Mahaffey page lists Chávez's Sinfonia India as the opener, while Ruth Eckerd Hall's page lists Gabriela Ortiz's Teenek and soprano Catalina Cuervo. Both records note the conflict.
4. Jannus Live pages give a single time without saying whether it is doors or show. JamBase differs for The Format (7:30 vs 6:30 pm) and Thundercat (8:00 vs 7:00 pm).
5. American Stage's season page does not name the park for Shrek the Musical... in the Park.
6. The Mahaffey listing and show page disagree on the date of Morning at the Zoo (Feb 10 vs Feb 11); that concert is not included.
7. Tampa Rep's Miracle on 34th Street page says "run December 3-23, 2025" in its header, but its Dates & Times block says December 3-23, 2026.
8. freefalltheatre.com carries injected casino-spam links in its footer (a compromised site); its show listings looked genuine.
